b: The FishUSA giveaway has ended: Were you one of the lucky winners?
Congratulations to our winners! We’ll be reaching out to you so we can get your gift cards headed your way. Thanks for entering! As always, keep an eye out for more weekly giveaways from Wired2fish.
Wired2fish was proud to partner with FishUSA to give five lucky anglers each a gift card valued at $50.

America’s tackle shop, FishUSA has something for every angler. It’s where you’ll find tens of thousands of products like rods and reels, baits and lures, line, hooks, electronics, apparel, specialized fly- and ice-fishing gear, electronics, boating equipment, and more.

Sure, the gift-giving season is coming up, but why not snag a little something for yourself? Whether you’re the angler who has everything or itching to splurge on the gear you’ve had your eye on all season, treat yourself with an extra $50 in your pocket. FishUSA gift cards can be conveniently used either online or at the FishUSA Pro Shop in Fairview, Pennsylvania.

The FishUSA giveaway dates ran from Nov. 2 to 16. This giveaway was open to entrants from both the U.S. and Canada. Five winners were selected at random from all eligible entries. Each received a gift card valued at $50. This giveaway has ended.
